_comment: Template settings.json cho service repo con (polyrepo). Dev sub-agent emit vao services/{{prefix}}-{{boundary}}/.claude/settings.json lan dau scaffold. Bo block 'allow' theo {{kind}}: GIU 1 trong 4 block backend/bff-web/mobile, xoa 3 block con lai. Day la permission cuc bo cho session chay RIENG trong service repo (ngoai orchestrator). Hook harness (dispatcher) song o design-repo cha .claude/settings.json — service repo KHONG co STATE.json nen KHONG wire dispatcher; chi giu permission allowlist + optional Stop guard local (xem _hook_note).
_hook_note: Hook orchestration (PreToolUse boundary-guard, Stop build/test gate, SubagentStop schema-check) chay o DESIGN-REPO khi spawn dev sub-agent — do la noi co STATE.json + scripts/hooks/dispatcher.py. Service repo standalone KHONG can va KHONG nen copy dispatcher (no phu thuoc STATE.json + MATRIX cua design-repo). Neu muon mot Stop-gate build/test cuc bo khi sua code trong service repo session rieng, them mot hook command don gian chay '{{build_cmds}}' va exit non-zero khi do — nhung mac dinh de TRONG de tranh phu thuoc. Gate build/test that su nam o Stop hook cua design-repo (chay khi stage in DEV/REVIEW_DEV/TEST_EXECUTE va co code thay doi trong services/{prefix-boundary}/).
